every_position_composed.reason: Frames 1 through 9 in both sites share identical camera compositions and framing along the scroll path.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D conveyor press, cabinet, and manifold metaphor across frames 1 to 9 to illustrate Straitjacket.
